title: Linear Regression Accelerator for FPGA
subtitle: Embedded Systems Course Project
bullets: Designed a memory-mapped 4-bit linear regression accelerator on Intel FPGA with a pipelined datapath for high-throughput accumulation and closed-form inference
Achieved near-floating-point performance (R² = 0.949) using quantized integer arithmetic in hardware
Wrote a custom C-based Linux device driver and user-space interface to control the accelerator and stream training data via AXI-lite to ARM Cortex-A9

title: ArcCell: RNA-seq Cell Type Annotation Tool
subtitle: Computational Genomics Course Project
bullets: Developed a robust cell type annotation tool for sparse scRNA-seq data using ArcFace-based supervised embeddings
Implemented a preprocessing pipeline with GF-ICF weighting, over- and under-sampling to enhance rare cell type representation
Achieved 96% F1-score on test data and 94% on out-of-sample validation, outperforming CellTypist baseline (62%)
Integrated SHAP-based interpretability for gene attribution, finding biologically relevant marker genes across datasets

title: RAG based LLM Chatbot
bullets: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot using LangChain and Ollama for enhanced context-aware responses
Implemented vector embedding and efficient document retrieval to improve answer relevance and accuracy
Integrated local LLM deployment with Ollama, reducing latency and ensuring data privacy

title: Reinforcement Learning based Chatbot
bullets: Design two chatbots (Agent A and Agent B) using policy gradient based training strategies so that they can handle prolonged meaningful natural conversations between them
Implement training techniques to give two separate personas for Agent A and Agent B.

title: Abacus based Mental Calculation using Neuromorphic Architecture
bullets: Implementation of different abacus based arithmetic operations to mimic mental calculations using Neural Engineering Framework.

title: Oceanic Data Visualization
subtitle: Data Visualization Course Project
bullets: Designed a web application to visualize various features of Indian Ocean and Arabian Sea during the period of 29 Dec 2003 to 29 Dec 2005.

title: 2048 Playing Agent
subtitle: Personal Project
bullets: Designed a reinforcement learning agent to play 2048 using different algorithms DQN, PPO, NEAT and Markov Trees.

title: Visual Programming Language
subtitle: Programming Languages Course Project
bullets: Web based visual programming language to emulate Turtle using Blockly transpiler for equivalent JS code generation.

title: Comprehensive Spectroscopic Data Processing and Visualization Tool
bullets: Designed a full-stack novel software tool for comprehensive data analysis of batch Raman spectra with features like background correction, peaks analysis, heatmaps, SNV, PCA-SVM analysis, spectral data libraries etc.
Utilised React and Apache ECharts for designing frontend and data visualizations of the analysed data provided by backend built using Python and Flask.
Embedded various machine learning models using Python and scikit-learn for determination of compounds for applications like identifying pesticides.

title: Image Captioning Tool
subtitle: Visual Recognition Course Project
bullets: A CNN-LSTM network was implemented using InceptionNetv3 as feature extractor to label various images provided in the publically available Flickr8K dataset.

title: Auto Rickshaw Detection
subtitle: Visual Recognition Course Project
bullets: Designed object detection model using YOLOv5 on self curated and labelled set of images of auto rickshaw.

title: Web Scraping Tool
subtitle: Personal Project
bullets: Program to scrape publication DOI and other details from different publisher websites based on user given keywords and record them in a database for ease of querying for researchers.

title: NLP based Sentiment Analysis
subtitle: Machine Learning Course Project
bullets: Machine Learning model for multiclass classification of a sentence into six different types of sentimentally hurting classes; hosted as Community Kaggle Competition.

title: Face Recognition based Security System
subtitle: Hackathon Project
bullets: Real time image pre-processing and face detection using OpenCV and Python integrated with pretrained Deep Learning model to determine strangers and owners.
